title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-001-018
doc_notes: This document consists of a series of personnel statements from FAA Air Traffic Control staff regarding the radar and visual tracking of an unidentified object reported by Japan Airlines Flight 1628.

encounters.summary: Japan Airlines Flight 1628 reported an unidentified aircraft with white and yellow strobes paralleling its flight path near Fairbanks, Alaska, which was intermittently tracked by radar.
encounters.quote: reported traffic at his altitude (FL 350), distance one (1) mile with a white and yellow strobe light
